description: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities in an attempt to collect credentials. Exploitation of a software vulnerability occurs when an adversary takes advantage of a programming error in a program, service, or within the operating system software or kernel itself to execute adversary-controlled code.

log_tail.pattern: jwt_verification event where result=valid and details.algorithm=none — a successfully verified alg:none token indicates active exploitation, not a rejected attempt

mitigation: Upgrade PyJWT to >= 2.4.0. Explicitly specify the algorithms parameter in all jwt.decode() calls to reject alg:none tokens. Validate the JWT signature against a known public key or shared secret. Never accept JWTs that claim algorithm=none in production. Rotate any secrets that may have been exposed to impersonated sessions.
